fato_historico: 2004: MK Airlines Flight 1602 crashes during takeoff from Halifax Stanfield International Airport, killing all seven people on board.
energia_do_dia: Today, the cosmos invites you to tenderly embrace your sensitivity. Just as the soft morning mist lifts from a quiet airport runway, you may find that clarity emerges after a period of stillness. It is a good time to honor the precious nature of life, perhaps by nurturing those you hold dearest with a warm, steady heart.
frase_do_dia: Cherish every moment, for life is a fragile and beautiful gift to behold.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual wisdom and the path toward internal emotional peace.
conselho: Practice mindfulness and offer gratitude for the safety and warmth of your home.
